title: Learning-Based Spectrum Cartography in Low Earth Orbit Satellite Networks: A Survey
summary: Low earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks are emerging as important infrastructure for global connectivity and space-based sensing, while their rapidly varying geometry, heterogeneous measurements, and dynamic propagation environments create challenges for acquiring and exploiting spatial radio information. Spectrum cartography provides a framework for constructing and updating spatial representations of radio conditions from sparse observations.
